note: Miri and loom checking (no application behaviour change). New CI jobs run the vespera_inprocess unit tests and the JNI-free unsafe helpers of vespera_jni (direct-buffer copy, uninitialised spare-capacity fill, u8 to jbyte view) under Miri, and model-check the JNI runtime lease gate and the dispatchAsync in-flight cap with loom (RUSTFLAGS="--cfg vespera_loom"). The shared-runtime gate now packs the in-flight lease count and the shut-down flag into one atomic word: entering is a single fetch_add instead of a SeqCst increment plus a SeqCst flag load, with the same guarantee (a dispatch is refused with 503 or waited for by shutdown0's drain).
